newsitem.title: UK: Ventspils crude line still shut but loadings resume.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils crude line still shut but loadings resume.

text.p: The crude pipeline feeding the Baltic port of Ventspils was still shut early on Friday after closing late Wednesday when storage tanks filled up, shipping sources said.
"The pipeline has stopped due to a full tank farm," the source said.
But weather conditions had improved sufficiently overnight to allow tankers to resume berthing.

The Hellespont Hope was scheduled to start loading 73,000 tonnes of Russian Urals crude at 0930 (local time). A second tanker, the Fosna, was due to start loading a similar quantity at midday, the source said.
Meanwhile, the Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk, Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally on Friday, shipping sources said.
